signal: Olo launched its first consumer-facing ordering app and the Olo Network, and acquired loyalty platform Spendgo after going private with Thoma Bravo

email.body1:
Charlene, saw Olo launch its consumer app and the Olo Network, plus the Spendgo acquisition after going private.

Moves that big usually open more in-market accounts than the revenue team can cover before they cool, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Olo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk through it with the right person on the CRO's team?
email.body2:
Charlene, quick follow-up for Olo.

After going private and launching new products, expectations on pipeline climb faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Olo needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps. Happy to loop in whoever owns this on the CRO's team.
email.body3:
Charlene, last bit of proof for Olo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Olo's reply rate likely compares to peer restaurant-tech platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Charlene, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters right after a take-private and a product launch, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a restaurant-tech motion? Happy to share it with the CRO's team either way.
